name: Pig Catcher
summary: Reworked the engine as a rounded casting and narrow cylinder with curved right header, rider with nearly upright shirt and tapered shoulder/neck, faceted MX dome/brow/chin and wraparound goggles, chamfered guards, real annular rope and corrected tank/shroud/mudguard transitions. Exported triangles: 2607 / 883 / 600 within original 2800 / 900 / 600 budgets. Original physics inputs, anchors, hinges and material stay frozen. LOD0 weighted silhouette .8504 to .8552; LOD1 .8497 to .8360 and LOD2 .8288 to .8026 regress. New current-geometry engine/torso gates reject the actual baseline at every tier. This remains below the ~.95 global likeness gate and is an explicit owner review candidate, not accepted parity.
